title: burnout paradise closes on december 1st and im telling you dont miss ...
transcript: I saw Burnout Paradise at St. Ann’s Warehouse a week and a half ago and I've been obsessed with it so much so that I'm going back tonight when I went the first time I was in the middle of the row kind of in the back and Burnout Paradise has like a lot of encouraged audience interaction so this time I'm sitting closer cause I wanna be part of the show which if you know me that's rare cause I am normally anti participation I like to watch but Burnout Paradise is this show that is fundamentally about community care and working together and I feel like I need it and I wanna be part of the community this time found Jeremy Jeremy hasn't done Burnout Paradise before so it's be fun. I got hot chocolate we're at the theater okay so I said we were close um we are quite close i love this show so much
